name: MAAT Protocol
rootCause: The Omnichain meta-yield aggregator MAAT tweeted that a security breach in the MAAT alpha version, resulting in unauthorized withdrawals of $240,000 USDT.

descriptions.text: The Omnichain meta-yield aggregator MAAT tweeted that a security breach in the MAAT alpha version, resulting in unauthorized withdrawals of $240,000 USDT.

MAAT Protocol on BNB Chain suffered a $168,000 loss in December 2024 when a withdrawal logic error allowed MEV bots to repeatedly withdraw outsized assets due to a share-burning flaw. A calculation error in the withdrawal logic left residual shares after withdrawal, enabling compounding incentives to inflate share value and permitting MEV bots to redeem outsized amounts with minimal share burn.
